objective: Test whether decoder-only S2 CCBS16 eligibility becomes measured same-resource decoder cycle reduction without exceeding a precommitted paired AEE budget.

excluded_without_new_capture: four bottleneck Conv3x3 layers owned by C1
scope_authority.c1_relation: Disjoint operator scope. C1 and S2 ratios must never be multiplied. A future unified replay may only add their measured operator cycles under one resource schedule.
scope_authority.c2_relation: S2 may gate the existing exact typed-signed K8 decoder backend, but metadata, bank ports, K8 waves, Acc24 service and completion remain charged.

eligibility_boundary.forbidden_translation: No eligibility percentage may be converted to speedup. In particular, 30.168202% is not 1.432x because fixed work, metadata, burst granularity, cache reuse, bank conflicts, psum service and commit remain.

policy_arms.role: exact zero-budget S2; must reproduce A bit-for-bit

paired_aee_protocol.prediction_identity: same ep34 checkpoint, source tree/config, deterministic seed, eval mode, preprocessing, recurrent-state reset and ordered 40-sample manifest for all arms
paired_aee_protocol.primary_metric: valid-pixel-weighted DeltaAEE over all 40 paired samples versus A_UNPRUNED
secondary_metrics: mean of 40 paired sample DeltaAEE values
all 40 per-sample baseline and candidate AEE values
paired_aee_protocol.exact_arm_gate: B_EPS0 prediction bytes or tensor values are bit-identical to A_UNPRUNED; max_abs_prediction_error=0 and DeltaAEE=0

address_timed_protocol.population: the same ordered 40 samples; a 30-sample cycle result is diagnostic only and cannot pass the joint gate
address_timed_protocol.baseline: strongest frozen exact decoder BIT_TYPED_K8 configuration on the same O16-bankable layout and the same decoder common-resource manifest
address_timed_protocol.candidate: baseline plus the selected S2 arm; no product-capture decoder configuration
mandatory_charges: M(G,O) metadata access for every decision
destination-by-O16 debt read-modify-write and its capacity
bank address, enable, tag and any separate metadata SRAM area/energy
cache hit, miss, refill, burst alignment and unused bytes in partially retained bursts
all weight and external port calendars and outstanding limits
two typed K8 source waves for each retained G16 block
terminal, close and dense commit even when a block is dropped
metadata conflicts on any shared physical port
address_timed_protocol.physical_suppression_gate: An O16 decision saves weight traffic only when its bytes occupy an independently suppressible bank row or external burst. Reading a full O96/1152-bit row and masking afterward saves zero fetch traffic.
reporting: ratio-of-sums local decoder cycles baseline/candidate over 40 samples
bytes and transactions by metadata, external refill, weight, psum and commit
stall cycles by bank, outstanding, dependency, compute and metadata conflict

quantization_bridge.reason: M1575 derives M(G,O) from ep34 FP32 weights while its byte count assumes hypothetical packed INT8 weights and the decoder backend is typed fixed-point.
must_freeze: integer scale and zero-point or signed symmetric quantization rule
conservative integer M(G,O) construction with upward rounding
proof that integer metadata never understates the fixed-point product bound

go_rtl_iff_all: one precommitted epsilon arm has overall paired DeltaAEE <= 0.02
that same arm has every-sequence paired DeltaAEE <= 0.03
that same arm has same-resource local decoder cycle speedup >= 1.15x over the strongest exact baseline
O16 physical bank/burst suppression and all metadata/debt charges are present
all 40 samples and the frozen quantization bridge are complete
joint_admission_gate.otherwise: NO_GO_RTL; retain only as an offline eligibility or appendix result. A byte-only reduction does not authorize RTL under M1604.

30 of 40 valid-mask tensors are absent locally

FP32-bound to deployed fixed-point/INT8 metadata semantics is not frozen
